notes: Sample standard for comparison with extracted code rules. Field names are matched by keyword (e.g. AMT matches PAY-AMT).

rules.name: Reject zero-amount payments
rules.description: A payment with an amount of zero must be rejected with the reason ZERO AMOUNT.

rules.name: Maximum single payment
rules.description: Payments above 500,000.00 must be rejected with the reason OVER LIMIT.

rules.name: Approved payment channels
rules.description: A payment must arrive through an approved channel: card, bank transfer or wallet.

rules.name: Supported currencies
rules.description: Only SGD, USD, THB and MYR payments may be processed; all others are rejected.

rules.name: Card fee rate
rules.description: Card payments are charged 2.90% of the payment amount.

rules.name: Wallet fee rate
rules.description: Wallet payments are charged 1.50% of the payment amount.

rules.name: Bank transfer fee rate
rules.description: Bank transfers are charged 0.40% of the payment amount.

rules.name: Volume discount
rules.description: For payments above 10,000.00 the fee rate is reduced by 20% (multiplied by 0.8).

rules.name: Fee calculation
rules.description: The fee is the payment amount multiplied by the fee rate.

rules.name: Minimum fee
rules.description: Every accepted payment is charged at least 1.00 in fees.

rules.name: Unknown channel handling
rules.description: The fee table must reject or default any channel value it does not recognise.

rules.name: Duplicate payment check
rules.description: A payment already processed in the same batch must be rejected as a duplicate.

rules.name: Sanctions screening hold
rules.description: A payment flagged by sanctions screening must be held and not processed.

rules.name: Conversion to SGD
rules.description: The SGD equivalent is the payment amount multiplied by the currency rate.
